newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle trade quiet, no sales -private.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle trade quiet, no sales -private.

text.p: Nebraska feedlot cattle trade was quiet near midday on Tuesday, with no reported sales, market sources said.
There were a few scattered packer bids at $105.00 to $106.00 per cwt on a dressed basis that were passed by owners asking $107.00 to $108.00, they said.
Bids on a live basis at $65.00 were passed by owners pricing cattle at $67.00 to $68.00, sources said.
Packer buyer interest was light following sales last week at mostly $106.00 to $107.00/dressed and $66.00/live that cleaned up showlists, cattle sources said.
